concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-manage-balance-accounts]] — 2026-09-15 Configuration API/Customer Area guide to account-holder-linked balance-account creation, viewing, description update and permanent zero-balance closure; examples do not prove funded state or payout.
warnings: Keep balance-account ID and account-holder ID distinct; associated payment-instrument cards are not payout-bank transfer instruments, and this page does not define platform liable/reserve account behavior.

Closure is permanent and only for an empty balance account; funds require a separate payout or internal transfer before closure, and closing is not account-holder deactivation or proof of fund receipt.
The sample EUR, zero-balance and active fields and versioned test snippets are examples, not account-specific state or universal currency/role constraints.
